policy.goal: Attempt every AMD/compiler lowering that could plausibly reduce APUSR shader cost or improve native Radeon ISA on Vulkan, D3D12, or the shared D3D11On12 path before qualification and PR splitting.
policy.ready_rule: Every non-deferred row must be implemented, probe-only, or explicitly blocked with a concrete reason. No silent unattempted rows are allowed.
policy.performance_rule: Canonical arithmetic is a candidate, not a native implementation, until Radeon ISA or a backend-native contract proves the intended instruction family.
policy.dx11_rule: DXC does not produce native DXBC. D3D11On12/shared shader-source opportunities stay in scope; a pure DXBC backend is recorded as outside this DXC branch rather than silently ignored.
policy.deferred_hardware: FP8/BF8/FP6/BF6/FP4 format families remain tracked but do not gate readiness until suitable hardware is available.

apusr_evidence.note: Counts exclude third_party, experiments, and AmdExtD3D definition headers; they are evidence of candidate consumers, not performance weights.
